title: Student Transportation Services Business Office Terms: Permit Cancellation, Capacity Revocation Credits and Credit-Balance Refunds
content:
These are the business office terms of Student Transportation Services for ending a courtesy rider permit and returning money to the family.

**1. Who cancels (in force).** Only the family cancels its courtesy rider permit; the support desk records a permit cancellation request and the family confirms it.

**2. Cancellation window credit (no longer in force).** A cancellation whose last day of service falls within the type's full-credit window (calendar days after the permit's start date, the start date being day 0) credits the permit fee net of its waiver and cap credits in full as a cancellation window credit; a later cancellation earns no credit.
*This clause is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current courtesy rider permit refund schedule under Board Policy CNA(LOCAL) for a family's own cancellation.*

**3. Revocation for seat capacity (in force).** When the district revokes a courtesy permit to free seats for eligible riders, the net fee is credited in proportion to the whole calendar months of the permit period left after the month of the last day of service, as a capacity revocation proration credit, rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up. The permit periods have 5 months (the fall semester and the spring semester) or 10 months (the school year).

**4. No credit (in force).** A permit revoked for conduct, or ended by district withdrawal or the end of its period, earns no credit.

**5. Refund of a credit balance (in force).** A credit balance is refunded by district check within 30 calendar days of the assignment ending or being cancelled (the refund days of the fee table), and a refund is issued only on an assignment in status ended or cancelled. The status is read from the district's assignment record.

## Capacity revocation, worked (hypothetical permits)

| Permit | Net fee | Last day of service | Whole months of the period left after that month | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| school year, 10 months | 240.00 | a day in January | February, March, April, May: 4 | 240.00 times 4 divided by 10, 96.00 |
| fall semester, 5 months | 135.00 | a day in October | November, December: 2 | 135.00 times 2 divided by 5, 54.00 |
| spring semester, 5 months | 67.50 | a day in May | none | 0.00 |

## Points of judgement

- **Refund on an open assignment.** None: a credit balance on an active or suspended assignment stays on the assignment; a refund is issued once it is ended or cancelled.
- **Conduct revocation.** No credit, whatever the month.
